tagline: Leading provider of onshore contract drilling and completion services in the United States
hero_kpi_rationale: Drilling Services Revenue is the primary driver of PTEN's business, representing approximately 35% of total revenue and directly reflecting the cyclical demand in the U.S. onshore oil sector.

kpis.name: Drilling Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from contract drilling operations in the United States.
kpis.description: The decline reflects reduced activity in U.S. onshore drilling, linked to expectations around crude oil prices.
kpis.signal: Revenue decline driven by lower drilling days

kpis.name: Completion Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from well fracturing and completion operations.
kpis.description: The decline is primarily due to pricing pressure on services, particularly in fracturing, with a $306 million decrease in fracturing operations.
kpis.signal: Sharp revenue decline despite stable pumping hours

kpis.name: Drilling Products Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from manufacturing and selling drilling tools, including drill bits.
kpis.description: The segment lost ground in Saudi Arabia and the U.S., but gained market share in Canada with improved pricing.
kpis.signal: Slight activity decline offset by stronger performance in Canada

kpis.name: Drilling Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating profit generated by the drilling segment.
kpis.description: Operating margin was preserved through cost savings and improved efficiency, with depreciation reduced by $114 million following the retirement of 42 legacy rigs.

kpis.name: Total Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain and modernize equipment and fleet.
kpis.description: Total capex declined across all segments (drilling -10.6%, completion -15.2%, products -0.4%), totaling $588 million versus $658 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in investments in response to lower activity levels

kpis.name: U.S. Operating Days
kpis.explanation: Number of days rigs are operational and billable in the United States.
kpis.description: Drilling days fell from 40,899 to 36,371, reflecting crude oil price expectations and increased drilling efficiency.
kpis.signal: Sharp activity decline reflecting onshore market contraction

kpis.name: Completion Services Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating profit or loss from the completion segment.
kpis.description: In 2024, an $885 million goodwill impairment dragged the result to -$898.5 million. In 2025, the segment improved to -$79.4 million despite persistent losses and a 10.5% revenue decline.

kpis.name: Other Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from oilfield rentals and interests in oil and natural gas reserves.
kpis.description: The sale of the oilfield rentals business in April 2025 explains most of the 49.7% decline. Residual revenue comes from oil and gas interests.
kpis.signal: Sharp drop due to divestiture of oilfield rentals business

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: PTEN does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in its recent financial filings. The company focuses on operational efficiency, cost reduction, and optimization of drilling and completion operations in a cyclical industry.
evidence: No mention of AI or advanced technologies in the 2025 10-K
No references to automation, machine learning, or predictive analytics
Absence of KPIs or projects related to digitalization or AI
